Author: Johnneylee Jack Rollins
Name: XivHud · Journal
Punchline: An adventurer's journal for an Umbra-centered Eorzea.
Description: An illustrated quest book with live accepted quests, search, local bookmarks, a parchment reading page and an optional compact quest tracker. Open from the server-info toolbar or /xivjournal; Appearance configures the tracker. The original journal remains available for native quest actions.
